mapper.sql: qual_id, type_id, qual_name, qual_level, qual_type, validity, remind, is_using, creator, open_status, to_char(update_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as update_time
mapper.select: select from cbs.t_contractor_qual where type_id = #{typeId} and qual_type = #{qualType} and open_status = true order by is_using desc, create_time
mapper.insert: insert into cbs.t_contractor_qual (qual_id, type_id, qual_name, qual_level, qual_type, validity, remind, is_using, creator, open_status) values (#{p.qual_id}, #{p.type_id}, #{p.qual_name}, #{p.qual_level}, #{p.qual_type}, coalesce(#{p.validity}, 0), #{p.remind}, coalesce(#{p.is_using}, true), #{p.creator}, #{p.open_status})
mapper.update: update cbs.t_contractor_qual set qual_name = #{p.qual_name}, validity = coalesce(#{p.validity}, 0), remind = #{p.remind}, is_using = coalesce(#{p.is_using}, true), update_time = now() where qual_id = #{p.qual_id} and open_status = true
update cbs.t_contractor_qual set is_using = #{using} where qual_id = #{id} and open_status = true
update cbs.t_contractor_qual set open_status = false where qual_id = #{id}
